source_text: De diebus Domini propheta: Orietur in diebus eius iustitia et multitudo pacis. Non de sola carne Salvatoris — tunc crucifixores non habuerunt pacem. Unusquisque actibus acquirit dies iustitiae vel iniquitatis. Timentibus nomen meum orietur sol iustitiae. Pax multa diligentibus legem tuam. Lux iustorum permanet; lux impiorum exstinguitur — non alia substantia sed Christus lumen aeternum versus falsa lux diaboli se in angelum lucis transfigurantis. Voluptas divitiae gloria saeculi — dies lucis exstinguendae; haeretici falsi nominis scientia.
pass_a_gloss: Concerning days of-Lord prophet: Will-rise in days his justice and multitude of-peace. Not concerning only flesh of-Savior — then crucifiers not had peace. Each-one by-acts acquires days of-justice or of-iniquity. To-fearing name my will-rise sun of-justice. Peace much to-loving law your. Light of-just remains; light of-impious is-extinguished — not other substance but Christ light eternal versus false light of-devil himself into angel of-light transforming. Pleasure riches glory of-age — days of-light to-be-extinguished; heretics of-false name knowledge.
pass_b_english: Of the Lord’s days the prophet says: [[In his days justice will arise and abundance of peace >> Bible:Psalm 72:7]]. Not only of the Savior’s fleshly sojourn — then his crucifiers had no peace. Each person by conduct acquires days of justice or of iniquity. [[For those who fear my name the sun of righteousness will rise >> Bible:Malachi 4:2]]. [[Great peace have those who love your law >> Bible:Psalm 119:165]]. [[The light of the righteous endures; the light of the wicked is put out >> Bible:Proverbs 13:9]] — not another substance, but Christ the eternal light versus the devil’s false light when he [[transforms himself into an angel of light >> Bible:2 Corinthians 11:14]]. Pleasure, riches, worldly glory — days of a light that will go out; so too heretics’ [[falsely named knowledge >> Bible:1 Timothy 6:20]].
notes: True OET; no copyrighted Judges FOTC.
